_doc: CREST effect policy — copy to effect_policy.json and customize for your project. All keys are optional; absent keys keep the built-in generic defaults.

hard_effect_patterns._doc: Overridable HARD effect regex patterns. Only 'network' and 'db' are supported. Patterns are matched against code-only source (comments/strings blanked).
hard_effect_patterns._network_examples: Project extensions: zeep SOAP → r"\bzeep\." | r"\bclient\.service\." | r"\.get_element\s*\(" | r"\bServiceProxy\b" | r"\bwsdl\b"

substrate_modules._doc: Modules granted infra-type signature-leak exemptions. Key = module relpath (relative to --src root, forward-slash separated), value = substrate label. A substrate module owns an infrastructure boundary (e.g. a DB session manager) and its functions are exempt from the signature_infra_leak_ratio gate.
substrate_modules._usage: Replace _example* keys with your actual paths. To activate, set this to a plain object: {"db_session.py": "db"}

_infra_roots_doc: Root import names whose types are treated as infra in signature-leak detection. This should be a JSON array when used. Project extensions to add: zeep, duckdb, openpyxl, pypdf, fitz.

infra_bare_types._doc: Bare type names (no module prefix) treated as infra. Default empty — set this to a plain array when used: ["DuckDBPyConnection", "TransportError"].
infra_bare_types._usage: Replace this entire object with a plain JSON array to activate.

ordering_verbs._doc: Regex patterns matched against raise-statement source to detect temporal ordering contracts. Default list covers generic English patterns. Set this to a plain array to override.
ordering_verbs._usage: Replace this entire object with a plain JSON array to override the default verb list.

infra_type_suffixes._doc: Type name suffixes used by the heuristic infra-leak detector. A public signature whose return/param type ends in one of these suffixes is counted as exposing infrastructure. Default covers common infra patterns. Set to a plain array to override.
infra_type_suffixes._usage: Replace this entire object with a plain JSON array to override the default suffix list.

_infra_exception_boundary_count_doc: Number of functions counted as infrastructure exception boundary owners. Set to the count of catch-and-rewrap functions in your substrate_modules. Default 0.
